description: The service behind a learning platform: courses with sections and videos, enrolment through orders, questions and answers on each lesson, notifications, and accounts with roles, documented in Swagger.
contributions: Built the API in TypeScript with Node.js, Express and MongoDB, over 69 commits
Built accounts: sign-up with verification, login, social login, refresh tokens, password reset, profile pictures and roles
Built courses: create, edit and delete, course content by section, and protected video playback through VdoCipher
Built questions and answers and comments on each lesson, and notifications that are cleaned up on a schedule
Built orders for enrolment and site layout settings for the front end
Cached sessions and hot data in Redis, stored images in Cloudinary, and wrote tests with Jest
results: Course delivery, enrolment and Q&A behind one documented API

body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: LMS API serves everything a course platform needs: instructors create courses with content sections and videos; students enrol through orders, watch protected videos, ask questions on any lesson and get answers; notifications keep both sides up to date. It is built to sit behind more than one front end.

body.heading: Built with
paragraphs: TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB; Redis for caching; Cloudinary for images; VdoCipher for protected video; Nodemailer and EJS for email; node-cron for clean-up; Swagger for documentation; Jest for tests.
